APP.TITLE: new-api-sync
APP.SUBTITLE: Sync pricing, channels, and models from upstream providers.

HEALTH.TITLE: Server health
HEALTH.DESCRIPTION: Runtime status of the sync server.
HEALTH.CONFIG_DESCRIPTION: Active config context and sync inputs.
HEALTH.ACTIVE_RUNS: {count, plural, one {# active run} other {# active runs}}

SYNC.TITLE: Sync pipeline
SYNC.DESCRIPTION: Run a full sync or reset managed resources.

FILTER.MODELS_PLACEHOLDER: Models filter, e.g. claude-*, gpt-4*, gemini-2.0-*

SYNC.EMPTY_IDLE: No run yet. Pick a mode and click Start.
SYNC.STOP_REQUESTED: stop requested, this can take some time

FILES.NAME: Name
FILES.CREATE_DESC: Creates config.name.yml, seeded from the current selection. Use letters, numbers, hyphen, or underscore.
FILES.INVALID_NAME: Use letters, numbers, hyphen, or underscore only.
FILES.DELETE_DESC: Removes the config file from disk. The main config.yml cannot be deleted.

TARGET.TITLE: Target
TARGET.DESCRIPTION: The new-api instance that receives the synced channels and models.

GLOBAL.TITLE: Global settings
GLOBAL.DESCRIPTION: Apply to every provider unless overridden per-provider.
GLOBAL.TEST_MODEL_TYPES_HELP: When set, only these model types are tested. Leave off for default (text only).
GLOBAL.BLACKLIST_HELP: Model names or globs to exclude from every provider.
GLOBAL.MODEL_MAPPING_HELP: Rename upstream models before they land in the target.
GLOBAL.GROUP_MAPPING_HELP: Replace a fragment inside upstream group labels before they become channel names. Key: fragment (or provider/fragment). Value: replacement. The rest of the label is kept.

GLOBAL_SETTINGS.TITLE: Cross-config settings
GLOBAL_SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Stored in config.global.yml. Applies to every config. Blacklist and model mapping here merge with per-config values (global wins on conflicts).
GLOBAL_SETTINGS.BLACKLIST_HELP: Models excluded from every provider in every config.
GLOBAL_SETTINGS.MODEL_MAPPING_HELP: Renames applied to every config. Global entries override per-config entries on the same key.
GLOBAL_SETTINGS.GROUP_MAPPING_HELP: Group label splices applied to every config. Global entries override per-config entries on the same key.

PROVIDERS.TITLE: Providers
PROVIDERS.DESCRIPTION: Each provider pushes channels into the target. Order matters: later providers override earlier ones on conflict.
PROVIDERS.CONFIRM_DELETE_DESC: This removes the provider from this config. The target will be cleaned up on the next sync.

VALIDATION.FAILED: Configuration is invalid. Fix the highlighted fields before saving.

SERVER.CANNOT_DELETE_MAIN: cannot delete main or reserved configs

ERROR.NEWAPI_FETCH_PRICING_FAILED: Failed to fetch pricing from both /api/pricing_new and /api/pricing
ERROR.NEWAPI_TOKEN_LIST_API_FAILED: Token list API returned success: false{detail}
ERROR.NEWAPI_CHANNEL_LIST_API_FAILED: Channel list API returned success: false
ERROR.NEWAPI_MODEL_LIST_INCOMPLETE: Model list snapshot incomplete: got {got} of {total}; refusing to sync (would soft-delete live model rows)
ERROR.CONFIG_PRICE_ADJUSTMENT_NEEDS_DEFAULT: {path}: priceAdjustment object must contain a default key
ERROR.CONFIG_PRICE_ADJUSTMENT_TEXT_LIMIT: {path}.{key}: priceAdjustment values for text types (vendors/default) must be < 1; only non-text types (image, video, audio, embedding) can be >= 1

COMMAND.UI_DESC: launch the web UI (Elysia and React dashboard)
COMMAND.METADATA_DESC: re-seed model metadata (release date, params, context, description) on existing models; no probing/testing, no channel or pricing changes
COMMAND.BALANCE_DESC: check the target and every configured provider's remaining balance; read-only, no probing or writes

OPTION.MODEL_TYPES: comma separated model types to sync (text, image, video, audio, embedding)
OPTION.DRY_RUN: preview pricing + diff without probing, testing, creating tokens, or writing to the target (no cost; logs still saved)
OPTION.METADATA_DRY_RUN: preview the group label renames the current groupMapping would apply to existing channels; writes nothing
OPTION.BALANCE_JSON: print the result as JSON instead of a table

BALANCE.TOTAL: Total: {amount} across {counted} providers ({skipped} without a balance)

SUMMARY.RESET_COMPLETE: Reset complete | Channels: -{channels} / ~{channelsUpdated} | Models: -{models} | Orphans: -{orphans} | Tokens: -{tokens} | Options: {options}
